value.rationale: The 2023 primary literature explicitly asks for escape-time scaling under discontinuity and gives a logarithmic generic class. The exact superattracting border at the natural mu=2 gain forces a distinctly faster double-log parameter clock for a specified physical initial density. The sharp growth regime distinguishes persistence of an attracting 2-cycle, a nonstationary critical ghost and eventual extinction, and supplies a substantive boundary to extrapolating the generic log class. It is a motivated analytic dynamical phenomenon, not an arbitrary finite sample or cosmetic parameter substitution.
